newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Urban Bank says to raise authorised capital.
newsitem.headline: Urban Bank says to raise authorised capital.

text.p: Urban Bank said on Wednesday it will build up its authorised capital to 5.0 billion pesos before the end of 1999 from the current 2.6 billion pesos.
"Plans are underway for a possible declaration of stock dividends out of the bank's retained earnings for this year," said bank chairman Arsenio Bartolome in a statement.
Between 1992 and 1996, Urban Bank has declared an average of 20.8 percent of cash and stock dividends yearly.
Apart from the stock dividends, the bank said it may raise its capital through a possible stock offering, issuance of convertible preferred shares, and stock rights and options.
The bank's plan to strengthen its capital was in response to a new ruling from the Central Bank setting higher minimum capitalisation for banks, the statement said.
